DISCUSSION
It is identified as a monostable multivibrator by the feedback circuit containing C1 and R3.
The circuit consists of two common emitter amplifiers. Notice that NPN transistors are used.1
Q1 amplifier uses R1, R3, R4 and R5 for biasing.
R1 is the collector load resistor. R3, R4 and R5 are voltage divider base bias resistors.
The Q1 base bias voltage is obtained from a voltage divider made up of R3 and R5..
Q2 amplifier uses R2 and R4 for biasing.
R2 is the base bias resistor and R4 is the collector load resistor.
C1 and R3 couple the output of one amplifier to the input of the other amplifier.
D1 and C2 are used to input the trigger pulse.
